statement: For any elliptic E/Q punctured at E[N], N>=2, and nontorsion R in E(Q), the exponents a in Zhat which are units at all but finitely many coefficient primes admit a full geometric abelian Selmer lift exactly when a is a nonzero integer. Their abelian fibres are unique point sections. The same exponent set holds for the intrinsic metabelian quotient. Over any number field, u(1-e_P)kappa(R) is excluded for every profinite unit u and nonempty finite P.
depends_on: A.2 finite-support neighbourhood argument; A.60 formal primary decomposition and Faltings; A.64 exact abelian fibres; Harari-Stix Theorem2.1; Stoll revised Theorem8.2; global and local Kummer injectivity; elementary rational-unit completion
answers: A.12 and Lead5: exact abelian and metabelian exponent sets on the entire almost-everywhere-unit family, including infinitely many coefficient alterations; all elliptic cubic twists and arbitrary E/Q; explicit necessary quadratic-cover diagnostic
notes: No CM, rank-one, finite-Sha or primitive-generator hypothesis. For a=m*u, every local centre is interior, including bad places; a rational boundary unit gives one completed Q-multiplicative class with finite integer valuations, hence one rational number and finite global support. Cofinal actual proper genus-one section-neighbourhoods and Stoll identify the full compact section globally; free Mordell-Weil coordinates then force u=+/-1. A finite nonempty zero-component set is excluded by the unit-multiplier extension of A60, using all cusp-unit functions, formal isometries and fixed finite-S Faltings. Actual metabelian fibres remain unclassified. Nonintegral exponents with infinitely many nonunit components remain outside this theorem. Exact eight K-squareclass covers, their two elliptic maps, nontorsion Prym points and finite-field counts are preserved as a diagnostic; the positive-rank cover does not obstruct the new proof. B independently audited the unit-multiplier extension.
